ITEM 1 | Pale white, opaque, soft-crumbly chunks with irregular torn edges and a few small yellowish flecks, mostly clustered on the left-center of the plate; covers roughly 25% of the plate (about 9 x 7 cm footprint), chunks about 1.5 to 3 cm, low dome height of about 1 to 1.5 cm, matte surface with no visible sheen, dry rather than juicy, does not hold a firm shape when touched | 90

ITEM 2 | Round, flat, light-brown crackers with a slightly textured, speckled surface containing darker dark flecks, about 2.5 cm in diameter and 0.5 cm thick; six pieces scattered in a loose arc across the lower-left and right-center of the plate, each appearing lightly toasted or baked with no glaze or char | 45
